name: github
description: Semantic repo search over GitHub with no API key and no login. A question ('a library that runs untrusted wasm in a sandbox') is expanded into several lexical queries, retrieved through GitHub's public search API, and re-ranked against the original question by a local embedding model — READMEs come from raw.githubusercontent.com, which is keyless and outside the API rate limiter. Connecting a GitHub account is optional and only raises the rate limit; it is delegated to the git module, so one mod key keeps one GitHub identity, stored off-chain in ~/.mod/git. Write endpoints are gated by the shared auth module's signed tokens.
